# Futu Announces Q3 2026 Results: Globalization Deepens, with Strong Resilience Across Businesses


Corporate News


--


(Hong Kong, November 19, 2026) — Futu Holdings Limited ("Futu" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: FUTU), a leading tech-driven digitalized brokerage and wealth management platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter that ended September 30, 2026.


In Q3, Futu's total revenues reached HK$6.69 billion (US$852.7 million), marking a year-over-year ("YoY") increase of 4.5%; its non-GAAP net income remained largely stable YoY at HK$3.27 billion (US$417.0 million). In terms of revenue segments, its brokerage commission and handling charge income amounted to HK$2.79 billion (US$356.1 million); interest income was HK$3.16 billion (US$403.0 million); other income (including income from wealth management and corporate services businesses) totaled HK$734.8 million (US$93.6 million).


By the end of the quarter, the combined number of registered users across Futu's platforms, Futubull and Moomoo, increased to 32.04 million, and the brokerage accounts to 6.87 million, reflecting YoY growth of 14% and 23%, respectively. The Company's funded accounts totaled 4.01 million, up 28% YoY. Client assets saw YoY growth of 8%, reaching HK$1.33 trillion (US$170.1 billion). Total trading volume across Futu's platforms reached HK$5.01 trillion (US$638.0 billion) in Q3, up 28% YoY.


Mr. Leaf Hua Li, Futu's Founder, Chairman, CEO & Chairman of the Technology Committee


, said: "During the third quarter, we continued to advance our globalization strategy. Our businesses demonstrated resilience across markets, while our brand influence continued to expand. We have always believed that the long-term value of a financial institution lies in its ability to maintain strategic focus amid market volatility and consistently invest in strengthening its core capabilities. Accordingly, in Q3 we deepened our local presence in each market, enhanced our wealth management capabilities, and improved the professionalism and accessibility of our services through technological innovation. While the benefits of these investments may not be immediately reflected in the current quarter's results, they're laying the foundation for Futu to navigate market cycles and achieve sustainable growth."


International Expansion Advances, With Overseas Business Continuing to Generate Value


In Q3, Futu further expanded its global footprint. Overseas funded accounts accounted for a growing proportion of the total, while overseas markets contributed an increasing share of overall growth. Overseas client assets grew 65% YoY by quarter-end, reflecting growing user trust and the tangible commercial value of Futu's international business.


Several markets have entered a phase of scalable growth. In Malaysia, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand, client assets more than doubled YoY. Southeast Asia was a particular highlight. In Singapore, Moomoo continues to expand its user base, despite already commanding more than 50% market share*, further strengthening its position as the market leader. While in Malaysia, Moomoo App downloads surpassed three million during the quarter, laying the groundwork for future market penetration. In North America, funded accounts grew steadily, supporting the Company's long-term growth prospects in these mature markets.


In addition, Futu secured a license in Thailand in Q3, with operations set to commence soon. This will create meaningful synergies with existing strongholds in Singapore and Malaysia, further reinforcing Futu's overall presence in Southeast Asia.


Brand Influence Reaches New Heights, Winning Trust Beyond Finance


As Futu's business foundations deepen worldwide, its brand influence is extending beyond finance into broader arenas. In response to the Hong Kong government's vision of establishing the city as "Premier Hub for Mega Events," Futu partnered with the Ladies Professional Golf Association ("LPGA") to bring the Ladies Golf World Championship to the city for the first time, and set a record for the highest prize purse in Asia. Moomoo also stepped into the global spotlight in Q3. In September, it was selected as the official US X Cashtag Partner, creating a seamless path from X to trading on Moomoo for millions of X users; In October, Moomoo participated in Malaysia's Youth Economic Forum 2026, contributing to high-level discussions on the country's economic future. The Company also continued to strengthen collaboration with leading financial institutions. In October, Futu partnered with ARK Invest to bring ARK's innovation strategy to eligible professional investors in Hong Kong, broadening their access to rare global investment opportunities. Meanwhile, Moomoo joined forces with Nasdaq to launch nationwide investor education programs in Australia and Canada. From social platforms and premier sporting events, to exchanges and global asset managers, Futu is completing its brand evolution from a "trading platform" to an "investment lifestyle brand".


Breakthroughs in Wealth Management and Private Wealth Management


Beyond brokerage, wealth management has emerged as an increasingly clear second growth engine for Futu. During the quarter, Futu worked with a number of fund companies to develop a more integrated operational model for its key products, with co-created content and joint campaigns. As of quarter-end, Futu's wealth management assets under management climbed to approximately HK$200 billion (US$25 billion), up 12% YoY, while the number of asset holders rose 23%. A growing number of clients are choosing to keep their assets with Futu for the long term, reflecting the Company's deepening positioning as a comprehensive financial services platform.


Futu also continued to invest in its private wealth business. In Q3, the Company established its second Institutional and Private Wealth Services Center in Hong Kong and introduced over-the-counter derivatives, further addressing the needs of high-net-worth ("HNW") clients and laying a solid foundation for the long-term development of this sector. Backed by diversified and hard-to-access product offerings, as well as a dedicated service model, Futu's private wealth business delivered strong growth in Q3: the number of clients in Hong Kong rose 35% YoY, while assets from HNW clients in Singapore increased by nearly 60% YoY. As Asia's two major wealth hubs, Hong Kong and Singapore are seeing Futu's differentiated value recognized by a broader base of HNW clients, who are choosing the platform as a long-time partner.


Building Long-Term Capabilities Through Products, Technology, and Operations


During the quarter, Futu continued to enhance its product and platform capabilities. The Company upgraded Futubull AI into an even smarter assistant, capable of delivering insights and analysis based on users' holdings and order history. It also launched the Moomoo Engine, which brings professional-grade research, options analysis, and technical trading tools together into a single experience, helping retail investors turn insights into action more efficiently. These initiatives are steadily narrowing the gap between retail investors and professional institutions because when sophisticated resources are within reach for everyone, the investing landscape becomes fairer. This reflects Futu's mission to "make investing easier and not alone."


At the same time, Futu continued to deepen its localization efforts across markets, building genuine roots in local communities and earning recognition from the public and private sectors. In Hong Kong, following the success of its "Futu Expo" brand event, the Company launched another flagship event "Futu Wealth Summit 2026" in Q3, attracting nearly 1,000 onsite investors and tens of thousands of users online. In Singapore, MooFest has grown into a major local investment gala, with registrations reaching a record high this year. In Canada, the Mayor of Markham visited the Moomoo store. In Australia, Moomoo was named "Most Trusted Micro-Investing App" by Finder. Through these efforts, Futu is becoming an integral part of the communities it serves. The Company is also committed to giving back and fulfilling its corporate social responsibility: in Malaysia, it donated RM100,000 to support a local charity, and in Hong Kong, it plans to hire approximately 2,000 professionals over the next five years to support the development of fintech talent locally.


By expanding the boundaries of finance through technology, Futu aims to make professional and accessible investment services available to everyone. This conviction has guided the Company from the outset and remains central to its long-term direction. With a global perspective, deep local roots, and an unwavering commitment to compliance, Futu looks forward to supporting investors around the world on their long-term investment journeys - moving steadily toward lasting success and making investing easier and not alone.


* The market share of more than 50% is calculated based on the number of Moomoo Singapore users as a percentage of Singapore’s local population aged 20 to 70. Population data is based on statistics published by the Singapore Department of Statistics as of mid-2026.
